analysis_protocol.bootstrap_interval: percentile 95% interval with linear interpolation; upper gate uses p97.5
analysis_protocol.combined_bootstrap: paired resampling within EN and RU strata, preserving cohort language counts
analysis_protocol.normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; map Russian ё to е; Unicode punctuation/symbol/separator/control to spaces; collapse whitespace. WER splits on spaces; CER removes spaces.
analysis_protocol.one_shot: Evaluator may be run only after exact complete shipping and candidate JSONLs plus run metadata are sealed. Partial scoring and rerunning after seeing metrics are prohibited.
analysis_protocol.per_language_bootstrap: paired resampling within the selected language
analysis_protocol.raw_candidate_is_primary: Quality gates apply to the raw intermediate result before any candidate-triggered shipping fallback.
analysis_protocol.scoring: micro WER/CER from summed edit errors and summed frozen reference lengths

canonicalization.input_requirement: mono 16 kHz PCM16 or IEEE-754 Float32 WAV; no resampling
canonicalization.mapping: PCM16 -> float32(sample_int16 / 32768.0); Float32 -> bit-exact payload copy after finite check
canonicalization.output: headerless little-endian IEEE-754 Float32 mono PCM

decision_rule.changes_after_unsealing: Any model, product-config, corpus, evaluator, threshold, or analysis change requires a new versioned preregistration and a genuinely untouched holdout.
decision_rule.joint: Each shape is an independent decision. Do not pool shapes or trade a pass on one against a failure on the other.
decision_rule.per_shape: INTEGRATE only if every hard gate is true; otherwise REJECT.

hard_gate_interpretation.bootstrap_upper: 97.5th percentile of the frozen paired utterance bootstrap; combined resampling is stratified by language
hard_gate_interpretation.cer: CER and paired CER intervals are reported but are not a hard acceptance gate.
hard_gate_interpretation.per_utterance: Any candidate-minus-shipping word-error delta >=2 is an immediate failure.
hard_gate_interpretation.token_structure: Both paths must have zero structural/emission failures. Exact-text SequenceMatcher alignment uses matched/max(shipping_count,candidate_count); aligned p95 start/end and confidence limits apply separately to tokens and words.
hard_gate_interpretation.vocabulary_false_negative: Shipping outcome is a candidate outcome while the intermediate candidate outcome is not.

run_contract.candidate_selection_requirement: Before any CoreML execution, append immutable candidate encoder MIL SHA/model path and shipping artifact identities to run metadata; this may not change corpus, scoring, or gates.
required_same_between_paths: same frozen PCM bytes and fixture order

scope.engineering_set_role: The existing frozen 122-reference <=7.5s corpus is development/engineering evidence only. It cannot be pooled into or substituted for holdout acceptance.
scope.holdout_role: One-shot acceptance for static 10.0s and 12.5s candidates versus shipping 15.0s. No partial scoring, optional stopping, threshold adjustment, or feature-gate fitting is allowed.
